screen.refugee.territory.title: Territory map
screen.refugee.splash.hint: ↑↓ / Mouse · Enter confirm · E / Esc close
screen.refugee.splash.guide.greeting: I'm the guide. Ask whatever you need.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.talk.0: Empty-hand a generic resident to make them follow. Sneak empty-hand for special residents.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.talk.1: A horn or bell selects nearby residents. A settlement banner teleports them.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.talk.2: Sneak-give swords/bows to guards, pickaxe/axe/hoe/shovel to workers. Use the command staff for warehouse, work, build, combat, rally, and guard.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.farewell: Watch your step. Come back if you need me.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.intro.seek: Hey, you noticed I'm different from the others, right? Why didn't you come talk to me?
screen.refugee.splash.guide.intro.0: Hi, I'm the guide. Why am I here? Because it felt reasonable to put me here.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.intro.1: Looks like this is your first time in this world. This command staff is yours.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.intro.2: What is it? Look at those dazed folks. They won't feed themselves. Get hurt by accident and they'll just slowly die. You can't ignore whether we live or die! T_T
screen.refugee.splash.guide.intro.3: Anyway: this lets you order them around. Residents with tools can build or do the jobs they can. Those with weapons can defend our land, or follow you into a fight.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.interrupt.0: Why did you cut me off?
screen.refugee.splash.guide.interrupt.2: Have we met? It's just a few lines, it'll be quick.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.warehous: Right-click a chest to add or remove it. Adding sorts logs, planks, stone, soil, and misc. Builders and miners pull from here. Mined ores go to the smelt warehouse. Lava buckets and similar fuel can stay here for smelters.
Farmers take seeds from here and put harvested crops back.
Kits and loose weapons go here. After you select followers, Combat Issue gear puts them on.
Right-click a chest to add or remove it. Hungry residents take non-seed food from here.
Right-click a furnace or blast furnace to add or remove it. Smelting workers fill whole stacks of ore from the smelt warehouse, then coal from there, then lava buckets from the block warehouse.
Mined ores, raw metals, and coal go here. Smelters take ore from here, and put ingots, stone, and empty lava buckets back. If it is unmarked or full, furnace items stay in the furnace.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.work.box: You can send them to chop trees, shovel dirt, mine stone, or farm. They still need the matching tools first. After a zone is marked, sneak-right-click its green box with the staff to cancel it.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.work.adv: They keep digging along the projection face of the area you marked. It's good for punching through tunnels. Sneak-right-click the green slice to cancel.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.work.rep: Set following residents to this state, and they will clear the blocks monsters left on your territory.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.work.bui: Set following residents to this state, then give them tools. You only need to place the blueprints, and they will go build those structures on their own.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.work.sme: Set following workers to this state. They tend marked furnaces: ore from the smelt warehouse, coal from there too, lava buckets from the block warehouse; products and empty buckets go back to the smelt warehouse.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.structur: Open the catalog, place a blueprint preview, then start the job. Workers must already be set to build.
Box two corners around an existing build, name it, and it joins the catalog for later building or repair.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.combat.g: Armed residents watch for nearby raids. They attack monsters around them, and they won't chase so far that they leave their post.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.combat.f: You can have warriors follow you as retainers. It doesn't do much for them, except maybe better gear.
After you select residents, pick a living creature and they will escort that target.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.combat.p: Short on people? Let warriors walk the gaps in your defense, moving between patrol points so they can answer surprises in time.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.combat.f: That's just stop following, all at once. You wouldn't want to halt them one by one.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.combat.e: After you select residents, combat can put gear-warehouse armor, weapons, and kits on them. Empty slots get filled. Anyone who already has gear won't be stripped for a kit, and workers keep their tools.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.combat.a: Nine logs craft a leather kit with a stone sword. Seven copper ingots and two copper blocks craft a chain kit with a bow and a stone sword. Seven iron ingots and two iron blocks craft an iron kit with a sword and shield. Seven diamonds and two diamond blocks craft a diamond kit with a diamond sword and shield.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.rally.me: Within horn range, pull residents holding melee weapons to follow.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.rally.ra: Within horn range, pull residents holding bows or crossbows to follow.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.rally.wo: Within horn range, pull tool-holding workers to follow.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.rally.ci: Within horn range, pull unarmed, tool-less generic residents to follow. Special residents are not included.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.rally.sp: Within horn range, pull the guide, nurse, cartographer, and enchanter to follow.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.rally.al: Within horn range, pull every resident you can command to follow, including special residents.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.guard.ad: Mark the residents currently following you as your guard. Each resident can belong to only one player's guard.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.guard.ra: Pull your guard members within horn range to follow.
Call the whole roster back. Distant members are force-loaded first.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.guard.re: Clear your guard mark from currently following residents.
screen.refugee.splash.guide.ask.secret.r: An unknown city hides a secret. Bring a mouth-bell, and wake them...
screen.refugee.splash.nurse.greeting: Hurt? I can patch you up if you have emeralds.
screen.refugee.splash.nurse.talk.0: The fee scales with missing health and armor, at least one emerald.
screen.refugee.splash.nurse.talk.1: I arrived with the first residents. Don't be stingy with a few gems.
screen.refugee.splash.nurse.talk.2: If you're already full, save the money. A walk outside helps more.
screen.refugee.splash.nurse.healed: There we go—one shot and you're good as new.
screen.refugee.splash.nurse.not_enough: Hmm~ perhaps bring a bit more coin to cover my medicine.
screen.refugee.splash.cartographer.greet: I keep this land in my head.
The more you occupy, the clearer the map.
Borders are yellow, others' land is red. Don't wander into the wrong color.
Open the territory map to zoom the view in or out.
screen.refugee.splash.cartographer.farew: Winds change. Borders do not redraw themselves.
screen.refugee.splash.enchanter.greeting: Books and lapis… that's my craft.
screen.refugee.splash.enchanter.talk.0: I'll stay near the enchanting table.
screen.refugee.splash.enchanter.talk.1: I refresh three enchanted books each day. Bring emeralds if you want one.
screen.refugee.splash.enchanter.talk.2: The table is given only once. Your organization shares that gift.
screen.refugee.splash.enchanter.farewell: The ink isn't dry yet. Until next time.
message.refugee.enchanter.gift_table: The enchanter gave you an enchanting table.
